# Endure Harm

> Datasworn `move.oracle_rollable:starforged/suffer/endure_harm.endure_harm` · 1d100

- [10] You suffer mortal harm. Face Death.
- [10] You are dying. Within an hour or two, you must Heal and raise your health above 0, or Face Death.
- [15] You are unconscious and out of action. If left alone, you come back to your senses in an hour or two. If you are vulnerable to ongoing harm, Face Death.
- [15] You are reeling and fighting to stay conscious. If you engage in any vigorous activity before taking a breather for a few minutes, roll on this table again (before resolving the other move).
- [50] You are still standing.
